license: this repository's own work (written in the AF2-design kit); attributions and both digests of each carried file in the package NOTICE
mechanism: triangle attention with per-head pair bias and key mask, forward + backward (jax.custom_vjp), Pallas (Triton lowering): triatt_attn.make_attention(**knobs) -> op(q, k, v, bias, key_mask, scale) (heads-major [B,H,S,D], bias [H,Sq,Sk] shared over B, d(bias) summed over B); attbwd_dkdv._bwd = the two backward kernels (dK/dV over key blocks; dQ + d(bias) partials over query blocks); kernels/triattn_xla's differentiable row runs attbwd_dkdv._bwd behind its pre-compiled forward
name: pallas_triatt
